verdict.rationale: Browserbase publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document ("Browserbase API", v1) at /reference/api/openapi.v1.yaml, and its llms.txt lists it under an "OpenAPI Specs" heading. The API reference pages and their "Try it" playground are generated from that published spec. The probe's 404s were on generic guessed paths (openapi.json, swagger.json), not the documented location, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of downloading and validating the spec file.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
